div.head: AGu 3
div.ab: ⁊ gyf man cynges ðegen beteo manslihtas, ⁊ he hine ladian durre, do hé þæt mid XII cynges þegnas; ⁊ gyf mon ðone man betyhð, þe bið læssa maga, ladie híne XI his gelicena ⁊ anum cyninges ðegene.

⁊ gif man cyninges ðegn beteo manslihtes, gif he hine ladian dyrre, do he þæt mid XII cinges ðegnum; gif man ðone man betyhð, ðe bið læssa maga ðone se cyninges ðegn, ladige he hine mid XI his gelicena ⁊ mid anum cyninges ðægne — ⁊ swa æghwilcre spræce ðe mare sy ðone IIII mancussas —; ⁊ gyf he ne dyrre, gylde hit ðrygylde, swa hit man gewyrðe.

Si thainus regis accusetur de homicidio, si se purgare uelit, faciat hoc cum XII thainis regis; si thainus accusetur, qui minus possit quam thainus regis, adlegiet se cum XI parium suorum et cum uno regis thaino — et sic in omni causa que maior sit quam IIII mance —; et si non audeat, soluat illam tripliciter, sicut adpretiabitur.

[Be ðegnum ðe betogene synd.] [Ld] ⁊ gif man cyninges ðegn beteo manslihtes, gif he hine ladian dyrre, do he ðæt mid XII cininges ðegnum; gif mon ðone man betyhð, ðe bið læssa maga ðone se cyninges ðegn, ladige he hine mid XI his gelicena ⁊ mid anum cyninges ðægne—⁊ swa ægehwilcre spræce ðe mare sy ðone IIII mancussas—; ⁊ gyf he ne dyrre, gylde hit ðrygylde, swa hit man gewyrðe.

If anyone accuses a king's thegn of homicide, if he dares to clear himself, he shall do so with [the oaths of] twelve king's thegns. If anyone accuses a man who belongs to a lower order that that of king's thegn, he shall clear himself with [the oaths of] eleven of his equals and one king's thegn. And this law shall apply to every suit which involves an amount greater than 4 mancuses. And if he [the accused] dare not [attempt to clear himself], he shall pay [as compensation] three times the amount at which the stolen property is valued.

(Über Thegnas, welche verklagt werden. Ld) Und wenn man einen Königsthegn des Todtschlags anklagt, wenn (und Ld) er sich rein zu schwören wagt, thu’ er das mit 12 Königsthegnas; (und B2) wenn man einen solchen Mann (Thegn Ld Quadr.) anklagt, welcher weniger vermögend als der Königsthegn ist, reinige er sich mit 11 seines Gleichen und mit Einem Königsthegn — und so bei jeder Klage, die mehr beträgt als 4 Mancussen —; und wenn jener [Verklagte diese Reinigung] nicht wagt, so vergelte er das [Eingeklagte] mit dreifachem Entgelt, je wie man es [gerichtlich] schätzt.

(Of thegns who are accused. Ld) And if a king’s thegn is accused of manslaughter, if (and Ld) he dares to clear himself by oath, let him do so with 12 king’s thegns; (and B2) if such a man (thegn Ld Quadr.) is accused who is of less standing than the king’s thegn, let him clear himself with 11 of his equals and with one king’s thegn — and so in every suit which amounts to more than 4 mancuses —; and if that [accused man] does not dare [this exculpation], let him pay for [what is claimed] with threefold payment, as it is [judicially] valued.
